independent_derivation_or_calculation: Block of dimensions b (width) and h (height) on incline. Toppling condition: Normal force shifts to the lower edge. Torque about CM: mg sin theta (h/2) = mg cos theta (b/2). tan theta = b/h. If sliding doesn't occur first (mu_s > tan theta), the block will topple when tan theta > b/h.
